incident.title: Cascading 504 Gateway Timeouts in Order & Payment Flow following Deployment v1.8.3
incident.summary: Payment Service HTTP 504 Timeout Surge correlated with deployment v1.8.3 (35m ago). Connection pool exhaustion at 98.4% causing cascading timeouts in checkout API.
incident.aiHypothesis: The sudden p99 latency spike (24ms → 412ms) immediately followed Canary Deploy #1094 (v1.8.3). Distributed tracing confirms 88% of slow traces stall inside the JWT signature validation middleware and HikariCP connection pool lock acquisition.
incident.aiRemediationRecommendation: Execute Instant Canary Depromotion (depromote canary-88a2 to stable-9c12) and run Runbook RB-209 to expand PostgreSQL connection pool ceiling.
